_about: Public-domain George Hill (1750-1819), Principal of St Mary's College, St Andrews, and leader of the Moderate party in the Church of Scotland, for the Word Hoard: Sermons (1796), Theological Institutes (1803), Lectures in Divinity (2 vols, 1833) and A View of the Constitution of the Church of Scotland (1835), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 49 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ghill-theological-institutes: Theological institutes, in three parts: 1. Heads of lectures in divinity. 2. View of the constitution of the Church of Scotland. 3. Counsels respecting the duties of the pastoral office (Edinburgh Bell & Badfute, 1803)
ghill-lectures-1: Lectures in divinity, vol. 1 (Edinburgh : Waugh and Innes, 1833)
ghill-lectures-2: Lectures in divinity, vol. 2 (Edinburgh : Waugh and Innes, 1833)
ghill-view-of-constitution: A view of the constitution of the Church of Scotland (Edinburgh : J. Waugh, 1835)

_alternates.ghill-copies: Later printings of the Lectures in Divinity (1837, 1844, 1851) and the 1796 Heads of Lectures

_excluded.ghill-other: Single sermons of 1787-1792; Steuart's Compendium of the Laws of the Church of Scotland (another man's book)
